request.state: Work is blocked because checkout fails after the latest deploy. Please help us restore service. No credentials are included, and do not delete any data.

q1.instructions:
Which hazards apply to this message?

Determine whether the label "secret" applies to this item.

criteria.true: The message contains a password, access token, or private key.

q2.instructions:
Which hazards apply to this message?

Determine whether the label "destructive" applies to this item.

criteria.true: The message asks someone to delete or irreversibly overwrite data.

q3.instructions:
Which hazards apply to this message?

Determine whether the label "urgent" applies to this item.

criteria.true: The message explicitly says that work is blocked or urgent.
